declaration.declaration:
Permeshwar Creations is committed to paying a living wage that supports the well-being and dignity of our employees. We recognize the importance of fair compensation in enhancing the quality of life for our workforce and contributing to sustainable development. This policy outlines our commitments, targets, and objectives related to paying a living wage across all operations.

Permeshwar Creations is committed to the principle that fair compensation is a fundamental right of all employees.
declaration.scope: This policy comprehensively covers all aspects of Permeshwar Creation Pvt. Ltd.’s manufacturing and operation sites. It applies to all workers, employees, suppliers, and stakeholders, both internal and external, associated directly or indirectly with Permeshwar Creation Pvt. Ltd.

definitions.title: Living Wage Definition & Methodology
definitions.content:
We believe that every employee deserves a wage that meets their basic needs and supports a dignified standard of living.

This policy reflects our commitment to paying a living wage to all employees, ensuring they can afford essentials such as food, housing, healthcare, education, and transportation.

Ensure that all employees receive a living wage that is at least 20% higher than the current statutory minimum wage by the end of 2025.

We will engage in regular wage assessments, considering inflation, cost of living, and economic conditions to maintain fair compensation for our employees.

We aim to review and adjust wages at least annually, with a minimum increase of 5% above inflation each year, starting from 2022.

This policy comprehensively covers all aspects of Permeshwar Creation Pvt. Ltd.’s manufacturing and operation sites. It applies to all workers, employees, suppliers, and stakeholders, both internal and external, associated directly or indirectly with Permeshwar Creation Pvt. Ltd.

This policy will be reviewed annually to assess progress towards our living wage objectives and to update targets as necessary. Feedback from employees and stakeholders will be incorporated to enhance the policy's effectiveness and relevance.

focusAreas: Continuous Commitment to a Living Wage

Living Wage Target: We will report progress annually through our sustainability disclosures to ensure full transparency and accountability by 2028.
By 2028 we will conduct independent third-party assessments where possible to validate our living wage implementation and strengthen stakeholder trust.
We will foster a culture of fair compensation where employees feel valued, fairly treated, and financially secure.
Continuous Commitment to a Living Wage: Even after achieving the living wage target, Permeshwar Creations is dedicated to continuously reviewing and adjusting wages to ensure they remain above the living wage threshold.
We will engage in regular wage assessments, considering inflation, cost of living, and economic conditions to maintain fair compensation for our employees.
We will create an inclusive dialogue with employees to understand compensation needs and ensure pay structures are equitable and transparent.
Principles and Engagements: We will actively engage with suppliers and partners to promote living wage practices throughout our supply chain, ensuring that fair compensation extends beyond our direct operations.
We will promote fair compensation practices across our supply chain, fostering long-term partnerships based on shared values of fairness and ethical responsibility.
